test_test_deterministic: test the deterministic behavior of sglang by running single, prefix, radix_cache, or p_vs_d test modes
run_send_single: run a single or batched prompt request against the sglang server and return the generated text output
run_send_prefix: run a batched prefix prompt request against the sglang server to test determinism with shared prefixes
review_TokenIdsAndLogprobs_compare: review the TokenIdsAndLogprobs.compare method that compares token IDs and logprobs between two sequences
run_BenchArgs: run the BenchArgs dataclass to configure CLI arguments for test mode, batch size, temperature, and sampling seed
